name: Silver Greatsword
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage, plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (such as with the *astral projection* spell), the gith can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.
